spec_match.rationale: Ten setPathData inputs called for real showing TypeError for missing required members and valid-prefix truncation otherwise; setPathData([]) removes d in Chrome 153 (explainer prose says d="" — surfaced, not hidden); getPathData returns the base value under CSS d: and SMIL; SVGPathSegList removal probed.

interactive.rationale: Case buttons, custom JSON input, CSS/SMIL toggles (aria-pressed) with Read now, and six legacy-operation port buttons.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises validation, base value and migration; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Edge/failure is the page's subject; invalid JSON is caught before calling the API.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4787972240179200 plus the SVG Paths spec anchor.

runtime_evidence.rationale: No chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment: verified with Playwright headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12, default flags and --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch; every case/toggle/port clicked in both modes; 0 console errors; 0px overflow. SMIL sampling while CSS d was also active in the scripted run; SMIL-alone sample not separately recorded.

telemetry_health.rationale: svgpd-base-value asserts the contract; validation/migration record observed outcomes and native vs fallback-labelled branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (shared path-demo.css + small inline blocks); every button override sets both background and color; status chips use emerald-dark/rose on paper/stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with text labels, aria-pressed toggles, labelled textarea, polite status outputs, SVGs role=img with titles.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Case grids collapse to one column; 0px overflow at 360px; mobile screenshot read.

openQuestions.title: Track the setPathData([]) and invalid-segment divergence from the explainer
openQuestions.detail: Chromium removes d for an empty array and truncates at the first invalid segment, while the explainer says d="" and 'silently skipped'. Check WPT svg/path/interfaces and Firefox; if Chromium changes, the page already reports live behaviour.

openQuestions.title: Record a SMIL-only base-value sample
openQuestions.detail: Exercise the SMIL toggle without CSS d: active and capture getComputedStyle().d vs getPathData() mid-animation.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use polite live regions for standard status updates, debounce frequently-changing regions, use role=img + title for non-decorative inline SVG, and provide data tables as alternatives for visual graphics.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status lines are role=status/aria-live=polite and debounced (250-400ms) where driven by sliders/typing/drag; each SVG has role=img (or role=group for the editor) with a <title>; segment data is always also shown as text/table.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Collapse multi-column layouts on narrow viewports, set min-width:0 on grid children, and wrap long unbreakable tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Shared path-demo.css: .split/.cases grids collapse to one column below 640-860px, min-width:0 on stage children, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/output; measured scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 in both modes.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons; expose toggle state programmatically.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: CSS and SMIL toggles are <button aria-pressed> with visible pressed styling (accent-blue/ivory).

summary: Built and self-reviewed in a cloud session without chrome-devtools-mcp; evidence is Playwright headless Chrome 153 with and without --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI.
